newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha touch firmer, but still slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha touch firmer, but still slow.

text.p: NWE naphtha was a touch firmer on Monday, but physical activity was sparse.
Dealers said not all market players were fully operational after the seasonal break, but that demand appeared to have improved.

"I've had two enquiries and I think petchem demand will be seen for the second half (of Jan)," said one seller. A mid-month paraffinic cargo was offered at high cif +$4 cif NWE while a full range cargo was hoping to attract a buyer at fob high $1 NWE. Jan swap talk was $224-226.
